class Left {
  #value = 1;
  #read(): number {
    return this.#value;
  }
  left(): number {
    return this.#read();
  }
}
class Right {
  #value = 'right';
  #read(): string {
    return this.#value;
  }
  right(): string {
    return this.#read();
  }
}
interface Both extends Left, Right {}
class Base {
  #shared = 0;
  shared(): number {
    return this.#shared;
  }
}
class First extends Base {}
class Second extends Base {}
interface Shared extends First, Second {}
const describe = (both: Both, shared: Shared): string => `${both.left()} ${both.right()} ${shared.shared()}`;
console.log(typeof describe);
console.log(new Left().left(), new Right().right(), new First().shared());
